name: simkl-timeline
author: Sylonin
description: Puts upcoming episodes and movie releases from your Simkl lists on the Pebble timeline.

usesPermissions.name: Internet
usesPermissions.reason: To sign in to Simkl, read your lists and mark episodes watched

usesPermissions.name: Internet
usesPermissions.reason: To get the airing schedule for the shows on your lists

usesPermissions.name: Timeline
usesPermissions.reason: To add upcoming episodes and releases to your timeline

plugin.description: Keeps the timeline pins for the user's Simkl lists (Watching, Plan to Watch, On Hold) up to date: new TV and anime episodes, and movie releases in cinemas or digitally. The Simkl Timeline watch app starts a sync, and each pin's Mark watched button records the episode or movie in the user's Simkl history.

actions.name: sync
actions.description: Refresh the upcoming airings from Simkl and update the timeline pins. Answers 'more' while work is left; call again until it answers 'done'.

actions.name: mark_watched
actions.description: Record an episode or movie in the user's Simkl history and remove its timeline pin.

actions.name: signin_start
actions.description: Start signing in to Simkl: gets a code for the user to approve at simkl.com/pin.

actions.name: signin_poll
actions.description: Check whether the user approved the sign-in code. Answers 'pending', 'approved' or 'expired'.

actions.name: watch_data
actions.description: Read what the Simkl Timeline watch app shows, as JSON: the signed-in account, a sign-in code in progress, the last sync status, the daily sync times and the upcoming list.
